newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher, contract highs set.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher, contract highs set.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on firm cash markets and new contract highs were set in all months, traders said.
Traders said cash markets remain firm and rice supplies, while plentiful, are slow to move into the marketing pipeline.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 750 contracts, above the 590 contracts traded Tuesday.
The new contract high for March is $11.63 per cwt, above the previous high of $11.57 set January 15.
Rice closed four to six cents per cwt higher, with March up four at $11.55.
